checks.topic: Complete physical rows and affine translation
checks.finding: Every original physical square is replayed against rational routed rows. One common rational affine virtual translation eliminates compact components of all unshifted rows. Pure compact rows require a shifted nonzero equal-and-opposite pair, supplying a finite-positive-eta gap. Rank/support classification uses every actual virtual-dependent row.

HEPKit U is compared to the exact Gaussian determinant. F is rebuilt exactly from eta, all independent virtual masses, signed shell diagonal invariants and every pair invariant. Pair coefficients equal -V_ij and are nonnegative polynomials; diagonal coefficients equal -V_ii and remain signed. This retains actual regulated shell information and rejects omitted/nonlinear kinematic pieces.

checks.topic: Actual line regulators and common phase
checks.finding: For future square-root pole energies with real spatial momenta, the reverse-Cauchy identity gives Re(2 q_i.q_j)>=0. Signed diagonal terms are purely imaginary. Thus the certified pair coefficients give Re F>=eta U S. When S=0, the affine condition implies Q=0 and only the negative imaginary independent virtual-mass average remains on nondegenerate faces. The 117 exact face/angle checks, including 54 S=0 checks, supplement the polynomial identities; they are not a replacement for the universal inequality.

All primary/nonparallel-pivot charts are enumerated. The maps cover the max-parameter domain, have the recorded x^(m-1) Jacobian, and check U=x U0 with nonnegative coefficients and exact positive pivot constant. Dividing the Gaussian mean/V cofactors by x must leave polynomials, so the required smoothness is checked rather than inferred from selected examples.

P sums actual positive virtual indices. R bounds polynomial insertion degree. J sums (cut_power-1)+(upper_power-1)_+ +(lower_power-1)_+, so lower contact derivatives are included. With B=max(2(P+R+J+2), radial bound, compact_count+2), D=B+1/5 and N=floor(B/2)+R+1, rank two obeys D/2+R<N<D/2+R+2 and D-P-J-N>0. N denotes exactly N Taylor terms of degrees 0 through N-1. Rank one sets N=0 and retains D/2-P-J>0. Checked dimension arithmetic rejects overflow.
